_doc: Every random process reads its seed from here by name (series rule). Main video seed 41, the series default.
_m4: M4 generated stills (scripts/stills.py): seeds 41-45 per prompt variant, the main seed 41 and the next four (Ever Present's M4 used 41-44 the same way). The O07 fog-tower plate uses the first four.
_m4_clips: M4 image-to-video clips (scripts/clips.py): seeds 41-42, the main seed and the next, as Ever Present's M4 clips. The second noise seed of the two-stage graph is seed + 1, as in Ever Present. m4_clips_v2 (43-44) is only for one revised prompt if both first seeds fail.
_m7b_park_concepts: M7b park concept stills and far-plate candidates (scripts/m7b_concepts.py, FLUX.2 [dev]): seeds 41-42, the main seed and the next, two takes per prompt. Reference for agreeing the park's direction, not footage (production log 40).
_m7c_plate_extend: M7c far-plate extension (scripts/m7c_plate.py --extend, FLUX.2 [dev] outpainting with a noise mask and differential diffusion): seeds 41-42, the main seed and the next, two takes per pass; the picked take per pass is in config/m7c_plate.json picks.
_m7c_o22d: M7c O22d (scripts/m7c_plate.py --o22d, LTX-2.3 image-to-video from the far plate): seeds 41-43, the main seed and the next two; the second-stage noise seed is seed + 1, as M4's clips.
